# Beer365

> Beer365 is beer intelligence for the whole beer business, built by Disruptive Advantage on Microsoft Azure and Microsoft Fabric inside the brewery's own tenant. It joins brewhouse, cellar, packaging, quality, supply chain, sales and finance data into one batch record, with dashboards, a digital twin and a generative AI copilot whose answers cite the batch and tag they came from.

## Key pages
- [Home](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/): what Beer365 does, how savings are counted and proved
- [Solutions](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/solutions.html): Beer365 across the whole beer business, area by area
- [Calculator](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/roi.html): brewhouse savings from your own figures
- [Pricing](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/pricing.html)
- [Contact](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/contact.html)

## Guides
- [AI in brewing, judged by what it saves in malt, tanks and beer](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-ai-in-brewing.html): AI in brewing judged by money: where forecasts, anomaly flags and a copilot pay back in a brewery, what to ask a provider and how Beer365 delivers it.
- [The beer data your brewery already has and what it is worth](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-beer-data-you-already-have.html): Beer data your brewery already has, from brew sheets to the excise register, joined by batch so it answers questions about money without new systems.
- [Brewery data on AWS without moving your stack](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-on-aws.html): Brewery data on AWS: Beer365 reads your Amazon S3 data where it sits, joins it into one batch record and leaves your AWS stack exactly as it is today.
- [Brewery data on Google Cloud, read where it already sits](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-on-google-cloud.html): Brewery data on Google Cloud: Beer365 reads BigQuery and Cloud Storage where they sit and joins them to brewing data, with no migration of your stack.
- [A brewery data platform on Azure and Microsoft Fabric, run in your tenant](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-platform-azure-fabric.html): Brewery data platform on Azure and Microsoft Fabric: one batch record across brewhouse, cellar, packaging and finance, delivered in your own tenant.
- [A brewery data strategy that starts with one question worth money](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-data-strategy.html): Brewery data strategy in stages: pick one question worth money, build one batch record, prove it against a signed baseline, then grow from there.
- [A brewery digital twin that knows what is in every tank](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-brewery-digital-twin.html): Brewery digital twin delivered live: what is in every tank, when it will be free and what is running late, fed by your own records inside your tenant.
- [Generative AI for breweries that cites the batch it read](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-generative-ai-for-breweries.html): Generative AI for breweries: a copilot in your own tenant that answers from your batch records, cites the batch and tag and never makes up a number.
- [Power BI for breweries, delivered by role and owned by you](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-power-bi-for-breweries.html): Power BI for breweries delivered as a service: role pages for brewing, packaging, quality and finance in your own tenant, with numbers that agree.
- [Predictive maintenance in a brewery, priced in beer and kilowatts](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/article-predictive-maintenance-brewery.html): Predictive maintenance for breweries: compressors, fillers and pumps flagged before they fail or waste power, read from data you already log.

## White papers and business cases
- [Brewery business cases: what one batch record is worth at four sizes](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/whitepaper-brewery-business-cases.html): Modelled brewery business cases at four sizes: beer loss, extract, energy, dumped batches and reporting savings, with assumptions and a conservative case. PDF: https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/downloads/brewery-business-cases.pdf
- [How beer AI vendors prove value, and how to test the claim](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/whitepaper-how-beer-ai-vendors-prove-value.html): How 116 beer AI companies justify savings claims: who publishes prices, methods and guarantees, plus ten questions to ask any vendor before you sign. PDF: https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/downloads/how-beer-ai-vendors-prove-value.pdf
- [The state of AI and data in beer, 2026](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/whitepaper-state-of-beer-ai-2026.html): 276 beer companies in an open dataset, counted by AI maturity, theme and country: where AI is shipping, where it is hype and where the gaps are. PDF: https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/downloads/state-of-beer-ai-2026.pdf
- [Beer365 readiness workbook (Excel)](https://ankurnapa.github.io/disruptive-advantage/downloads/Beer365-Readiness-Workbook.xlsx)
